payload.why_it_matters: 5 of 7 sub-blocks are dead, yet status=ok. The fx_coupling block is the sharpest case: it carries is_estimate=false while three of its five numeric fields are 0. Any downstream plausibility check that trusts is_estimate will treat 0 VND buy/sell and 0 CNY/VND as real observations. This is the feedback_nonzero_values_need_plausibility_check class, on a live tool.
